texts: good. the universal over Keepers parses as a fireable rule with the quantifier word recorded, and the belief is sealed under the considering event, so nothing asserts that sky-cats really are sacred.
good. "never" parses as the same per-Keeper rule at strength zero, with the sky-cat object varying per Keeper inside the rule; fireable, with nothing lost.
